verdict.rationale: Docusign's own docs claim workflow automation through its IAM platform, configurable workflows, and a drag-and-drop editor for designing contract processes. That points to automations users can set up, but nothing shows them running autonomously in the background without a human or agent kicking them off. The MCP and Gemini CLI evidence describes agent-initiated, on-demand actions rather than background automation. Missing for 10: documented background triggers or schedules, evidence of unattended or autonomous execution, details on how automations are configured and monitored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
